        - fieldId: avlwd

      - filterOperationType: AND
        filters:

        - fieldId: ar5hk

          value: 6900d321c5e12e8b70baf172
        - fieldId: a2jnt
          filterType: equals
          value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Terms.result.signal_source }'
        - fieldId: avs2k
          filterType: equals
          value: 6900d338eb02a90bc1276d52
        - fieldId: avlwd
          value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Terms.result.client_name }'
          filterType: equals
      - filterOperationType: AND
        filters:
        - fieldId: a7ctw
          filterType: equals
          value: 6938624b2ba0aeef7a5e96d8
        - fieldId: ar5hk
          filterType: equals
          value: 69eb73e8443b6ea1c2816d40
        - fieldId: avs2k
          filterType: equals
          value: 6900d338eb02a90bc1276d52
        - fieldId: avlwd
          filterType: equals
          value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Terms.result.client_name }'
        - fieldId: a2jnt
          value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Terms.result.signal_type }'
          filterType: equals
      - filterOperationType: AND
        filters:
        - fieldId: a7ctw
          filterType: equals
          value: 6938624b2ba0aeef7a5e96d8
        - fieldId: ar5hk
          filterType: equals
          value: 6900d325b8eb17cb9f03c40a
        - fieldId: avs2k
          filterType: equals
          value: 6900d338eb02a90bc1276d52
        - fieldId: avlwd
          filterType: equals
          value: All
      - filterOperationType: AND
        filters:
        - fieldId: a7ctw
          filterType: equals
          value: 6938624b2ba0aeef7a5e96d8
        - fieldId: ar5hk
          filterType: equals
          value: 6900d31e37d586e5aafc5f2a
        - fieldId: a2jnt
          filterType: equals
          value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Terms.result.signal_name }'

          value: 6900d321c5e12e8b70baf172
        - fieldId: avs2k
          filterType: equals
          value: 6900d338eb02a90bc1276d52
        - fieldId: avlwd
          filterType: equals
          value: All
        - fieldId: a2jnt

          value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Terms.result.signal_source }'
      - filterOperationType: AND
        filters:
        - fieldId: a7ctw
          filterType: equals
          value: 6938624b2ba0aeef7a5e96d8
        - fieldId: ar5hk
          filterType: equals
          value: 69eb73e8443b6ea1c2816d40

          value: 6900d338eb02a90bc1276d52

      limit: 100
    recordActionType: search
    meta: {}
    delay: 0

  Prepare_Search_Terms:
    title: Prepare Search Terms
    type: transformation
    description: Normalizes signal inputs (name, type, source, rules) replacing empty values with NULL for consistent KB article searches
    on-success:
    - Find_Related_KB_Articles: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      signal_name:
        title: Signal Name
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: 'inputs.Signal_Name ? inputs.Signal_Name : "NULL"'
          data:
            inputs:
              Signal_Name:
                $:ref: $inputs.Signal_Name
        actionType: jsonata
        next: signal_type
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      signal_type:
        title: Signal Type
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: 'inputs.Signal_Type ? inputs.Signal_Type : "NULL"'
          data:
            inputs:
              Signal_Type:
                $:ref: $inputs.Signal_Type
        actionType: jsonata
        next: signal_source
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      signal_source:
        title: Signal Source
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: 'inputs.Signal_Source ? inputs.Signal_Source : "NULL"'
          data:
            inputs:
              Signal_Source:
                $:ref: $inputs.Signal_Source
        actionType: jsonata
        next: signal_rules
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      signal_rules:
        title: Signal Rules
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: 'inputs.Signal_Rules ? $distinct([inputs.Signal_Rules]) : []'
          data:
            inputs:
              Signal_Rules:
                $:ref: $inputs.Signal_Rules
        actionType: jsonata
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        next: client_name
      client_name:
        title: Client_Name
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: 'inputs.Organization_Name ? inputs.Organization_Name : "All"'
          data:
            inputs:
              Organization_Name:
                $:ref: $inputs.Organization_Name
        actionType: jsonata
        next: load_client_list
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      load_client_list:
        title: Load Client List
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: assets.AI_SOC_Clients_List
          data:
            assets:
              AI_SOC_Clients_List:
                $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Clients_List
        actionType: jsonata
    entrypoint: signal_name
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Signal_Rules_Loop:
    title: Signal Rules Loop
    type: loop
    description: Iterates through each signal rule in parallel to search for associated KB articles
    on-success:
    - Merge_KB_Article_Record_Search_Results: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - Get_Rule_ID_and_Rule_Name
    actions:
      Get_Rule_ID_and_Rule_Name:
        title: Get Rule ID and Rule Name
        type: transformation
        description: Extracts rule_name and rule_id fields from the current signal rule iteration
        on-success:
        - Find_Related_KB_Articles_Rules: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        transformations:
          rule_name:
            title: Rule Name
            description: ""
            display:
              functions:
              - function: lookup
                inputs:
                - '{ $:ref: $loops.Signal_Rules_Loop.value }'
                - rule_name
              advancedView: false
            inputs:
              expression: $lookup(loops.Signal_Rules_Loop.value,'rule_name')
              data:
                loops:
                  Signal_Rules_Loop:
                    value:
                      $:ref: $loops.Signal_Rules_Loop.value
            actionType: jsonata
            next: rule_id
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          rule_id:
            title: Rule ID
            description: ""
            display:
              functions:
              - function: lookup
                inputs:
                - '{ $:ref: $loops.Signal_Rules_Loop.value }'
                - rule_id
              advancedView: false
            inputs:
              expression: $lookup(loops.Signal_Rules_Loop.value,'rule_id')
              data:
                loops:
                  Signal_Rules_Loop:
                    value:
                      $:ref: $loops.Signal_Rules_Loop.value
            actionType: jsonata
            next: ""
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
        entrypoint: rule_name
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Find_Related_KB_Articles_Rules:
        title: Find Related KB Articles for Rules
        type: recordAction
        description: Searches KB articles matching rule name or rule ID to find rule-specific documentation
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
          applicationName: ""
          applicationId: aGzNhSudxmEKmZM3F
          filters:
          - filterOperationType: AND
            filters:
            - fieldId: a7ctw
              filterType: equals
              value: 6938624b2ba0aeef7a5e96d8
            - fieldId: ar5hk
              filterType: equals
              value: 693846dff165c5075cf22c46
          - filterOperationType: OR
            filters:
            - fieldId: a2jnt
              filterType: equals
              value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Rule_ID_and_Rule_Name.result.rule_name }'
            - fieldId: a2jnt
              filterType: equals
              value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Rule_ID_and_Rule_Name.result.rule_id }'
          - filterOperationType: OR
            filters:
            - fieldId: avlwd
              filterType: equals
              value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Terms.result.client_name }'
            - fieldId: avlwd
              filterType: equals
              value: All
          filterType: AND
          returnFields:
          - tracking-id
          limit: 100
        recordActionType: search
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
    loop:
      type: for
      each:
        $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Terms.result.signal_rules
      parallel: true
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Merge_KB_Article_Record_Search_Results:
    meta: {}
    title: Merge KB Article_Record Search Results
    type: transformation
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: Combines tracking IDs from signal-based and rule-based searches, removing duplicates to output unique KB articles
    transformations:
      merged_kb_article_tracking_ids:
        title: Merged KB Article Tracking IDs
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: >-
            (
                $kb_records_1 := actions.Find_Related_KB_Articles.result.records.'tracking-id' ;
                $kb_records_2 := actions.Signal_Rules_Loop.result.Find_Related_KB_Articles_Rules.result.records.'tracking-id' ;

                $distinct([$append($kb_records_1, $kb_records_2)]) ;

            )
          data:
            actions:
              Find_Related_KB_Articles:
                result:
                  records:
                    $:ref: $actions.Find_Related_KB_Articles.result.records
              Signal_Rules_Loop:
                result:
                  $:ref: $actions.Signal_Rules_Loop.result
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: merged_kb_article_tracking_ids
meta: {}
